parsed.name: Robotiq Hand-E机械夹爪
parsed.description: 用于机器人末端执行器的两指电动夹爪，可通过网络套接字直接连接并控制，支持激活、开闭状态判断、开合位置自动校准，以及按目标位置、速度和力执行夹持运动，适合实验自动化中的样品抓取与转运。
parsed.description_en: A two-finger electric robotic gripper used as an end effector, directly controlled over a network socket. It supports activation, open/closed state checks, automatic calibration of open and closed positions, and gripping motions with commanded position, speed, and force for sample handling and transfer in lab automation.
